notes.title: The Unbeatable Path - Version 2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h2]Gamepad Support[/h2]
[list]
[*]Customizable button mapping for gamepads.
[*]UI dynamically adjusts to gamepad buttons.
[*]Cursor movement via left gamepad stick & click via face button bottom (A).
[/list]
[h2]Steam Deck Officially Verified[/h2]
[list]
[*]Steam Deck specific controls implemented.
[*]Optimized performance for Steam Deck.
[*]Automatic performance adjustments when launched on Steam Deck, with a manual option available in the settings.
[*]Improved readability of various UI elements on Steam Deck.
[/list]
[h2]Sound Effects[/h2]
[list]
[*]Numerous sound effects across the game have been revised and improved.
[/list]
[h2]Difficulty System[/h2]
[list]
[*]Option to choose difficulty level (Easy / Medium / Hard).
[*]Interactive objects and items are highlighted on Easy and Medium; no highlighting on Hard.
[*]Highlighting range depends on the selected difficulty.
[/list]
[h2]Text Display in UI[/h2]
[list]
[*]Notes and books can now display text in the UI for better readability.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Numerous code enhancements for all UI elements and their behavior.
[*]Texture Optimization: Improved performance & reduced download size.
[*]Improved water visuals along the shorelines in the levels Outer Sanctum and River of Styx.
[*]Significant performance improvements in cutscenes.
[*]Revised animations and adjusted skeletal meshes for cutscene characters.
[*]Tutorial messages no longer close automatically and can now be closed manually.
[*]Added a tutorial for opening doors and drawers.
[*]End credits are now skippable.
[*]Reduced hold time for skipping cutscenes to 2 seconds.
[*]Improved lighting throughout the game.
[*]New 2D UI graphics for the Good/Bad system.
[*]Improved or replaced various textures and materials.
[*]Various other code improvements.
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]UI: Fixed a bug where UI elements were displayed at the wrong depth layer.
[*]Subtitles: Fixed an issue where subtitles were displayed even when the menu was open.
[*]Graphics: Resolved flickering issues for lava and other meshes at certain distances.
[*]Adjusted surfaces where incorrect materials were used, causing incorrect footstep sounds, among other issues.
[*]Fixed an issue where the skip cutscene button needed to be pressed twice to register.
[*]Addressed minor lighting issues.
[*]Resolved a bug in Mia’s story cutscenes where the intro text remained visible after skipping the cutscene.
[*]“Skip cutscene” is now only displayed in the UI when skipping is actually allowed (affects short cutscenes).
[*]Expanded the interaction area for the living columns in Chapter 6.
[*]Fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where a platform did not move, even after reaching the next section of the tower.
[*]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in the item inspect view.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you for playing The Unbeatable Path! 🎮[/h2]

notes.title: Development Update October 2022
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle lovers,

with this update for the month of October you will receive the last regular monthly development update for [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
Since I have almost completed the game and am now moving more into polishing and marketing, I will be posting smaller update news from now on as the appropriate milestones are reached. I'm proud to have reached this point of development and I'm looking forward to the last stage before the release.
Now to the actual October update: The penultimate map "Outer Sanctum" has been completely finished and the last level "Inner Sanctum" has also been almost completed. When this one is done, the remaining voiceovers will be implemented, the whole game will be optimized and the final trailer will be created. From this point on I will start with the marketing campaign.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]"Outer Sanctum" completed:[/b] the puzzle of the level was extensively tested and optimized based on this outcome. Some 3D models were also reworked, more particle effects were created, jumpscares were implemented and the transition to the final map was implemented as well.
[*][b]"Inner Sanctum" almost finished:[/b] in this level the player goes on his last way over narrow paths and through the gates of hell to the grand finale. The level design has almost been completed but the various end sequences are still missing and will be implemented during November.
[*][b]"Inner Sanctum" 3D models, effects and materials created:[/b] since the player is in the deep interior of hell in this map, accordingly a lot of new 3D models, particle effects as well as many materials were created and optimized to reflect this environment immersively.
[/list]

[h1]Eye Candy[/h1]
Here is a sneak peek of the final level "Inner Sanctum".
All assets are still in progress and can therefore still change in the final game.

notes.notes:
Hello horror friends,

next month is just around the corner, which means for us: time for the development update of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i] for the month of September.
This month I've been going full throttle again and almost finished the penultimate map "Outer Sanctum". Some 3D models, effects, sounds and the level design were finished. In addition, I have already planned a playtest for the level and the next recording session for our voice actress, which will take place soon. All in all it was a very productive month again.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]"Outer Sanctum" almost finished:[/b] The level is relatively wide and reflects the harsh landscape of hell well. In this map, the player has to climb a mountain and solve the final puzzle to enter the last level "Inner Sanctum". The level is 80% completed and in the next step, we will do a QA test and implement some missing cutscenes.
[*][b]3D models created:[/b] For the new level, some new 3D models for the environment and the puzzle were created. You can get a small glimpse of them below.

notes.title: Development Update August 2022
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle friends,

it's time again for the next development update for [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i] for the month of August.
Before we start, here's an important announcement: The final Early Access release date has now been set to February 2023. More about this in the detailed project progress overview.
Now to the actual monthly update: We were able to finish the new Keyart and based on it we also reworked the whole Steam page. The store page now reflects the current state of the game except for the trailer. We also finished the map "River of Styx" and worked on the missing cutscenes.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Postponing the release date to February 2023:[/b] The game is currently 80% complete and I could meet the original deadline of October this year, but still want to take more time to polish the game further to achieve the best possible quality I can as a single developer. Also, I still have a 3 month period scheduled to create a trailer and boost marketing in that time frame. Hence the delay to 2023.
[*][b]"River Of Styx "finished:[/b] The map including the level cutscenes is now finished. Some effects like fog, smoke, fire and other particles were added. Some 3D objects were reworked and all collisions were adjusted and tested.
[*][b]Steam presence reworked:[/b] The entire Steam store page including the keyart, logo, descriptions, screenshots and game scenes have been completely reworked. The Steam page and graphics now reflect the current state of development of the game, except for the trailer.
[*][b]Story Cutscenes:[/b] Currently some story cutscenes of Mia are still missing for the already finished levels "Staring Woods", "Endless Manor" and "River Of Styx". For these, 3D objects, animations and the level design are currently being created. This task is expected to be completed next month.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update June 2022
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle friends,

Welcome to the June development update of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
This month we were able to complete the newest map "Endless Manor". We also implemented a new skybox and together with it we optimized and improved the lighting conditions of all maps. Also, the code was optimized for several systems. On the one hand, the level streaming system was reworked and on the other hand, the save/load system was optimized.

[h1]Project progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]"Endless Manor" completed:[/b] the performance problems that had shown up in our last gameplay tests have been completely fixed and the gameplay now plays as ideally as intended due to the new map layout, among other things. After all gameplay and performance tests were positive, we can now start with the next map "Ocean Of Pain".
[*][b]Skybox reworked:[/b] the quality of the skybox did not meet our qualitative expectations and was therefore completely reworked. The new skybox now reflects the hell setting much better and prompted us to make further improvements to the other maps.
[*][b]Level tweaks:[/b] to better show off the skybox, we massively removed the visibility limit on some maps, reworked the fog, and optimized the lighting for a better, more immersive gameplay experience that matches the setting. This resulted in a completely new look for open levels, as best seen in the screenshot of the map "The Awakening".
[*][b]Levelstreaming system reworked:[/b] to get the most out of lighting the maps, the levelstreaming system has been reworked so that we load & unload lightmaps during gameplay to ensure optimal lighting along with the best performance.
[*][b]Save/Load system optimized:[/b] the Save & Load system has been optimized so that there is now much less code for the entire system. This in turn leads to optimized save & load speed and less problem-prone code.
[/list]

Here are some visual impressions of the improved systems and the new map.
All assets are still in progress and can therefore still change in the finished game.

notes.title: Development Update May 2022
notes.notes:
Hello puzzle friends,

and welcome to another development update from [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
In May we were able to complete 90% of the next map called "Endless Manor". This level takes place in an old manor house and holds some surprises for the player. More assets were created for this map and we also found the time for a playtest. Based on this, we had to make some fundamental adjustments to the map, as some gameplay & performance problems had become apparent. We will finish the new level in June.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New map "Endless Manor" 90% complete:[/b] In Endless Manor, the player enters an old manor house that is haunted by some restless souls. The many corridors hold some surprises for the player and are designed to change dynamically depending on how the player is moving. The sound design, along with the other infernal assets and creatures, still creates an oppressive and terrifying feeling in this somewhat lighter environment.
[*][b]Quality assurance & gameplay tests:[/b] The new map was extensively tested for potential bugs, gameplay issues, and performance. It turned out that the new map was a bit too small and a new gameplay mechanic had a strong impact on performance. Based on these tests, the map layout was completely reworked and improved. The performance problems have also been completely fixed.
[*][b]3D Modeling & Animation:[/b] Besides some new assets created for this map, new animations found their way into the game as well. One of them is an animation of a ritual that the player has to perform in order to advance in the level.
[*][b]Lighting revised:[/b] Since you can play through the whole game in one flow and without loading screens, there were problems with the lighting calculation in some places. These have now been fixed by moving all the lighting for each level out into more sub-levels and we only load the lighting of those sub-levels when it is needed. 
[/list]
[h1]Eye Candy[/h1]
Now for the fun part: here you can find some screenshots of our new map "Endless Manor".
All assets are still in progress and can therefore still change in the finished game.

Hello puzzle friends,

a new month is just around the corner, which means for us: time for the next development update of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
This month our main focus was the completion of the new map "Staring Woods". In addition to the level design, further 3D models, animations and the intro of the level were completed. We also tested the map extensively and found time for another voice actor session.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Completion of the map "Staring Woods":[/b] As expected, we still needed the whole month of April to complete the new map. With a total of 4 puzzles awaiting the player in this level, this map is the largest in the entire game so far. All 4 puzzles are completely different and must be solved in order to advance to another smaller area within the map. There the player will have to solve another mini puzzle to reach the next level "Endless Manor" (working title).
[*][b]Quality Assurance Tests:[/b] Also this month our QA has had a lot to do with extensively testing the further implemented puzzles and finding possible bugs. Based on these tests, the 4 puzzles of the map were optimized and found bugs were fixed.
[*][b]3D Modeling & Animation:[/b] for the remaining puzzles some 3D models and animations were still missing. These have now been completed and implemented. The intro took some time here, as the player falls from the sky into the new map, giving an impression of the remaining levels of the game from a long distance.
[*][b]Voice Actor Session:[/b] this month our voice actress was busy again and recorded all missing voice overs in another recording session for our main character Mia.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update March 2022
notes.notes:
Hi puzzlers,

now that [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i] is about halfway finished, we took the time this month to test the entire project and fix the bugs we found. This took some time, but still didn't stop us from partially implementing the new map "Staring Woods" and creating the corresponding assets for this level.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Playtest:[/b] This month we took a lot of time to test the content so far. In addition to gameplay tests, our QA also performed collision tests and sound tests, just to name a few. A collision test, for example, checks whether the character is blocked by certain objects. A sound test, for example, checks whether the sound slider for effects in the menu also affects the corresponding sound effects (for example, a fire) in the game.
[*][b]Bugfixes:[/b] Based on the bug list of the playtest, all bugs found by our QA were fixed. At the same time, the code was further optimized to prevent future bugs as much as possible.
[*][b]New map "Staring Woods":[/b] We have also started to implement the next map "Staring Woods". The player will now advance further into hell with this map, which will now reflect the hellish environment more clearly. The level design including the puzzle gameplay is 50% complete at this point. Since this is a somewhat larger outdoor map that includes 4 separate puzzles, we are probably still busy with the completion of the entire month of April.
[*][b]3D Modelling & Animation:[/b] For the new level, of course, many new 3D objects are needed. Since the world is now turning more and more into a real hell, we are currently in the process of creating and animating many organic-looking assets. You can find a foretaste of this below.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update February 2022
notes.notes:
Hey puzzlers,

and again the month is coming to an end, which means for us: time for the next update on the game progress of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
In general, we have made quite a bit of progress with development in February. The code was optimized and centralized, a new puzzle was implemented, more motion capture sessions including face capture and a voice acting session were done.
We also reached a big milestone and are happy to announce that we have completed about 50% of the total game development.

[h1]Project Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Motion Capture Sessions:[/b] Some scenes were shot with our motion capturing system, which we were still missing for the existing levels. Each level now has an intro where a demon roughly explains to the player how to solve the next puzzle. For this, the animations were recorded and implemented via motion capturing.
[*][b]Update of existing animations with face capturing:[/b] Our existing animations were extended with facial animations. For this, we use a system just like motion capturing to record the facial animations and transfer them to the character. This has now been done for all existing animations and was integrated into the game.
[*][b]Voice Acting Session:[/b] There were still some voice recordings of the demons missing in the game. These were recorded in a voice acting session and also already implemented in the game.
[*][b]Another map "Tower of Choices" completed:[/b] With the level "Tower of Choices" the following puzzle to the level "Enigma Hall" (working title before: "Hallways") was completed. This is again different from other puzzles in the game, as the player must act very quickly here to solve the puzzle. With this level, the player also completes half of the entire game.
[*][b]Code/script optimizations:[/b] At many points in the game we always fall back on the same functions. So far, these have been implemented in every file as good as new. To keep the code and the Unreal Engine Blueprint Scripting clearer and simpler, the functions have now been optimized so that we maintain them in a central location and now only have to call them where they are needed.
[/list]

And again this month you get a visual impression of our game progress.

notes.title: Development Update January 2022
notes.notes:
Hey puzzlers,

time flies by and January is almost over, time for a development update of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
In this month we finalized the gameplay mechanics, 3d models, and the level design for the main riddle of our latest map called "Lost Hallways" (working title). This map is almost done and will also contain an additional puzzle that is less complex than the main one. The smaller puzzle will be finalized at the beginning of February and we will start working on the next map after that.

[h1]Game progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Improvement of the persistent level:[/b] all environmental foliage assets have been replaced with better ones. The layout of the whole persistent level has been adjusted and more "hellish" content has been added to it.

notes.title: Development Update December 2021
notes.notes:
Hey puzzlers,

Christmas and New Year's Eve are just around the corner, so it's time for another development update for [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].
Before we start with the updates, I would like to use this special time of the year to thank all the supporters and interests of this project. We have had a tumultuous year with many ups, but also some downs. Without your support and interest in this project, we would not have been able to overcome these hurdles, so once again to all of you a big thanks for your support.
We are very happy about how this project has developed and are proud to tell you that our processes and workflows have been established in such a way that we will be able to gradually implement the content that is still planned next year without any major problems.
In this spirit, we at RecklessGames wish you, your families, and friends a wonderful Christmas and a Happy New Year!
Now to the actual development update.

[h1]Game progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Level "The Room" implemented:[/b] This level is the third level in the game and is a bit smaller compared to the other levels, but also trickier. The level was completely finalized and QA tested this month.
[*][b]Another cutscene created:[/b] To further reveal Mia's story, we created another cutscene and implemented it in the level "The Room". In addition to the required assets, we also conducted a motion capturing session to record the characters' animations.
[*][b]Improved environment of all maps:[/b] All playable levels are subordinated to one main level, the so-called Persistent Level. This level is used by us to maintain cross-level game mechanics, but also to present a persistent environment in the background for all levels. This environment has been completely overhauled and now corresponds to our quality level.
[*][b]3D models created:[/b] In the game, placeholders for various 3D models were still used for the first levels, these have now been replaced with the final 3D models.
[*][b]Development of the level "Hallways" started:[/b] We started working on the new map called "Hallways" (working title) this week, for which we will probably need the whole of January to finalize it.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update November 2021
notes.notes:
Hey puzzlers,

time flies by so it is time for another development update. This month we were very busy implementing a localization system, as well as a subtitle system. We could also do another voice actor recording session and also finish the second map "Awakening".

[h1]Game progress[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Localization system:[/b] We've successfully build and implemented a complete localization system for [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i]. This will make it quite easy to implement new languages once we are done developing the game in our base language (English). This system doesn't only support text, it is also used to localize other assets like textures for example. Especially for the puzzles, it is necessary to localize textures as well for a better understanding of those. Another benefit of this system is that you can change the language during gameplay. The text will then be shown in your chosen language on the fly.
[*][b]Implemented German as a new language:[/b] German is the first language we've implemented with our new localization system to test the localization of our game during development. We will continue to localize all of our upcoming content in german during development and once the game is done we will outsource the localization for other languages to a localization agency when everything runs smooth.
[*][b]Subtitle system:[/b] We've also implemented a subtitle system that you can turn on and off during gameplay. This system is also based on our localization system.
[*][b]Recording session with our voice actress:[/b] We did a new recording session together with our voice actress Jasmin for our main character Mia for all the voiceovers that were missing for the first three maps. Those audio recordings have then been gone through our post-production pipeline and were then implemented in the game.
[*][b]Finished map Awakening:[/b] Awakening is our second map and has been overhauled during the last month. We've adjusted a lot of events, implemented new meshes, and updated a lot of textures and materials. We also produced the intro cutscene and implemented some other sequencer events as well.
[/list]

[h1]Eye Candy[/h1]
As always we have some eye candy for you of our current progress. Keep in mind that those screenshots represent our current progress of the game. Means: things may and will change during development.

notes.title: Development Update October 2021
notes.notes:
Hello friends of The Unbeatable Path,

to give regular development updates, we decided to post our progress of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i] every month from now on. You will also get any news or announcements in that kind of post. Have fun reading!

[h1]Team development[/h1]
We are proud to announce that we have more manpower covering this project since September. This helps us to achieve a better quality in all aspects of the game. This should also help us reaching our goal of a early access release at the end of next year or the beginning of 2023.

[h1]Game progress[/h1]
We are currently working hard to finalize our following todos:
[list]
[*] [b]Main Character:[/b] we are using a completely new and high-quality skeletal mesh for our main character "Mia". This mesh is still work in progress and needs some more polishing, especially for the different cloth textures.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] we worked a lot on the UI in the last months and have finished the design of it already. This design is currently being implemented for all our interface elements.
[*] [b]Movement system & animations:[/b] we've added several new animations for the main character and did an overhaul of the movement system in general. In detail, this means that we've replaced some of the existing animations, adjusted the timings of the animations, added new animations, defined a new movement speed and you are now able to strafe while crouching (this was highly requested by our community who tested the Indiegogo/Kickstarter demo).
[*] [b]Map progress:[/b] the first map, called "Rebirth" is almost finished and needs just some polishing. We also already started working on the second map, called "Awakening" which should be finished at the end of next month. For both of the maps there is mainly minor adjustments and some cutscenes missing which leads us to our next point. 
[*] [b]Cutscenes:[/b] to create good looking cutscenes we are working with motion capturing animations which we are creating on our own with the help of the Rokoko SmartsuitPro & gloves. This system together with some keyframe animated events (with the help of control rigs) results in a good and affordable way to produce animations for our cutscenes.
[*] [b]Voiceovers:[/b] the voice over scripts for the first two maps are done and in November we will start recording those with the help of our voice actors.
[/list]

[h1]Demo update[/h1]
Today we've hidden the demo from the shop site since it does no longer reflect the game anymore, cause we are constantly improving all aspects of the game and won't stop doing so until the game is released. We mainly used the demo to have a very early build that we could show to our Kickstarter and Indiegogo supporters to give an insight of the look & feel of [i]The Unbeatable Path[/i].

[h1]Eye Candy[/h1]
This is it for our monthly update, don't hesitate to ask any questions in this thread.
But enough said for now, here we have some eye candy for you.
